# Owned Object formal and primitive array result fixture

An Object-bounded method input has no generic relation to its opaque byte-array
result. Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every recovered unit and
preserve original entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen direct,
separately compiled, reflection and MethodHandle callers run 96 fresh JVM cases
twice. They check exact input/array identities, nulls, aliases, signed bytes,
empty arrays, callback mutations, caller writes and exact late failures.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving controls guard scope and erasure.
Only owned fixture code executes. Use JDK 25 for verification; originals use
release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
